kids.name: Inspection Technique
kids.work: Inspection methods carried by scanners and robots.
kids.where: Method-dependent inspection targets.

kids.name: UT / corrosion mapping
kids.work: Ultrasonic measurements map remaining wall thickness and local metal loss.
kids.where: Pipe walls, vessels, tanks and structural steel.

kids.name: PAUT / phased array
kids.work: Electronically steered ultrasonic beams inspect welds and material volumes.
kids.where: Welds, complex joints and selected corrosion inspections.

kids.name: TOFD
kids.work: Time of Flight Diffraction detects and sizes flaws using diffracted sound from flaw tips.
kids.where: Pipe and vessel welds, including subsea configurations.

kids.name: DRS
kids.work: Dynamic Response Spectroscopy estimates steel wall thickness through difficult coatings.
kids.where: Coated pipes, risers and other compatible steel components.

kids.name: EMAT / CHIME / Multiskip
kids.work: Guided-wave or multi-path screening identifies areas that need detailed follow-up.
kids.where: Long pipe sections and difficult-access pipe regions.

kids.name: MEC / MEC-FIT / HFEC
kids.work: Electromagnetic techniques inspect corrosion or flexible-riser armour. Their penetration and targets differ.
kids.where: Coated steel, risers and armour-wire layers.

kids.name: ACFM / ACFMT
kids.work: Detects and sizes surface-breaking cracks, including on complex weld geometry.
kids.where: Structural nodes and weld surfaces.

kids.name: VLS / photogrammetry
kids.work: Video Laser System captures geometry, wear and corrosion-pit dimensions as 3D data.
kids.where: Flex joints, fairleads and mooring chain links.

kids.name: InspeCT
kids.work: Computerised-tomography technique listed for flexible-riser assessment and imaging of layers.
kids.where: Flexible risers. Manufacturer and model details are not specified on the reviewed page.

kids.name: PEC / Lyft PECA
kids.work: Pulsed eddy current screens average wall thickness through coatings or insulation. Lyft PECA is a named external instrument.
kids.where: Coated or insulated steel components, including piping.

kids.name: Fairlead inspection crawler

kids.name: Under-Tank Scanner
